hooks.name: team-memory-pull
hooks.description: Pull the latest shared memory, register the Basic Memory project, refresh the skill copies, report notes flagged review_needed, then open this session's ledger - in that order, in one action (Kiro does not promise the order of separate hooks). Output is added to the agent's context. Kiro IDE only: SessionStart is not available on Kiro CLI or Web, where you run `uv run -q --script scripts/sync-memory.py pre --then-session` by hand.
